title: L2 WAF & SSLO Engineer - F5 BIG-IP-k
description:
Job Title: L2 WAF & SSLO Engineer F5 BIG-IP 
 Experience: 5+ Years
 Locations: Bhubaneswar, Kharghar, Belapur, Nagpur
 Work Mode: Work from Office – Onsite
 Shift: 247 Rotational Shifts
 Domain: Network Security / Cybersecurity Operations 
 Job Description We are looking for an experienced L2 WAF & SSLO Engineer to manage, support and troubleshoot F5 BIG-IP Web Application Firewall (WAF/ASM) and SSL Orchestrator (SSLO) platforms in a critical banking environment. The candidate will be responsible for protecting web applications against security threats, managing WAF policies, troubleshooting SSL/TLS traffic inspection, resolving security incidents and ensuring compliance with security policies and operational SLAs. 
 Key Responsibilities Provide L2 operational support and administration for F5 BIG-IP WAF/ASM and SSLO platforms. Monitor security alerts, platform health, performance and availability. Troubleshoot web application security incidents and SSL/TLS traffic-related issues. Configure, deploy and tune WAF security policies, exceptions and application protection rules. Configure F5 SSLO for SSL/TLS traffic decryption, inspection and re-encryption. Implement standard configurations for new applications and services. Perform root cause analysis (RCA), incident containment and remediation. Escalate complex issues to L3 engineers and F5 Technical Assistance Center (TAC). Maintain SOPs, runbooks, technical documentation and incident records. Ensure configurations comply with security policies and banking regulatory requirements. Coordinate with application, network, security and other technical teams for incident resolution. Mandatory Technical Skills Hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP WAF/ASM . Practical experience with F5 BIG-IP SSL Orchestrator (SSLO) . Good knowledge of F5 BIG-IP LTM, HTTP/HTTPS and SSL/TLS. Experience in WAF policy configuration, tuning and troubleshooting. Strong incident management, troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills. Education & Certifications BE/B.Tech in Computer Science/IT, BCA/MCA or a relevant master's degree. Required certifications as specified by the client: CEH/CCNA/CCNP Security and an OEM F5 certification such as F5-CA/F5-CTS (two certifications in total). Important Requirements Minimum 5 years of relevant experience. Willingness to work onsite at the assigned location. Willingness to work in 247 rotational shifts. Candidates should have hands-on F5 WAF/ASM and SSLO experience, not just general firewall or network monitoring experience. Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV, current CTC, expected CTC, notice period and preferred location.

Key Skills: Assembly,F5,Orchestrator,Web Application Firewall,SSL,L2
